messages:
rachel: quick check1 switched the models list to a "snap-tab" across columns. usability test: screen reader users reported chattiness and the focus ring seems to jump when layout reflows. anyone seen this before? :eyes:

tony: are the cards implemented as buttons? that matters for semantics and focus handling.

rachel: yes, each model is a button opening a detail flyout. DOM is still row-major, CSS grid handles columns.

priya: recommendation: use role=grid + role=row + role=gridcell for a true 2D control. keep Tab to enter/exit the grid (single Tab stop on container) and implement Arrow key navigation with roving tabindex. this avoids surprising Tab behaviour for SR users.

priya: accessibility details: add aria-posinset and aria-setsize on each gridcell so AT can announce "item X of Y"; keep aria-label concise: "Model: NAME, item X of Y, STATUS"; debounce the aria-live updates ~200ms to reduce spam when arrowing quickly.

priya: visual fix: avoid translate/scale on focus (that moves element out of flow). instead use an outline or subtle box-shadow token to prevent UA focus rect jitter. ensure focus token meets 4.5:1 contrast on dark theme.

rachel: good call. also add a small visible helper above the grid "Use arrow keys to navigate, Enter to open" and an offscreen description that reads on focus with control hints.

a11y-bot: scan result: focus-outline (dark) contrast ratio 3.1:1; threshold 4.5:1. Issue A11Y-777 created.

tony: I'll prototype roving tabindex + arrow handlers and swap the focus styles to a non-layout-affecting token. will post a demo link here when ready. :thumbsup:
